Jangan silap anggap BN menang di Johor tanda kembali diterima, kata MP PAS. Walaupun BN tampilkan Onn Hafiz Ghazi sebagai 'poster boy' berimej 'bersih', Syahir Sulaiman mempersoalkan sama ada gabungan itu mampu tawar perkara sama pada PRU16.

Don’t mistake Johor win for full BN revival, says PAS MP. While BN had the 'clean and popular' Onn Hafiz Ghazi as its poster boy in Johor, Syahir Sulaiman questions if it can present the same package in GE16.

PAS paid heavy price to kill off Bersatu in Johor, says Puad. The former Umno leader says the incoming Johor government should not give the Islamic party any of the five appointed assemblymen's post.
